tool: supabase execute_sql (single transaction ending in rollback)
build: supabase/tests/build_assurance_candidate.ps1 -Slice A3 (A1, A2, A4, A4b, A3 DDL+tests in install order); executed text is the build output with SQL comment lines removed (comments only; every statement, including the fail-on-any-failure diagnostic block, was identical)
syntheticSourceData: no additional module data; reuses the synthetic tenant and actors of the earlier suites and grants assurance.plan.manage to the synthetic manager and reviewer roles inside the transaction
covers: 24 tables force RLS; planning API authenticated-only; helpers not client-callable
risk rating bands over likelihood x impact; deterministic occurrence periods
universe categories and owners validated; registration replays its receipt; ids unique
risk assessment needs planning capability and independence from the area owner; stale versions rejected; history retained and immutable
templates are exact allow-lists, requests must reference template controls, versions are appended and immutable
only risk-assessed areas are planned; an area owner cannot lead its audit; frequency allow-list; one active item per area
a submitted plan is locked; the maker cannot approve; approval needs recent MFA; return-to-draft and resubmit
uncovered high/critical areas are shown to the approver; approval records approver and a digest; approved plan and items cannot be rewritten
engagements come only from approved plans, need engagement authority, are bounded by frequency, replay their receipt and are created once per occurrence
instantiated engagement takes the occurrence period, planned lead, template controls and PBC requests owned by the area owner, and one creation event
instantiated engagements keep A1 independence rules and version history
retired areas are not instantiated; areas in open plans cannot be retired; approved plans are not cancelled
evidence viewers read the universe; external reviewers, other tenants and wrong-branch reads are refused
one plan or universe event per aggregate version; planning history immutable
notCovered: reminders, escalations and overdue dashboards (FR-6823 remainder)
automatic scheduling of occurrences; instantiation is an explicit command
plan amendments after approval (a new plan is required)
doesNotEstablish: the organisation's actual audit universe, risk scale or plan cadence (as-is discovery not done)
